            des na mthong ba'i laM gyi sbyor ma kho na'i khyad par brjod do || <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4294">khyung po</rs> na re 'byed kyi °°°°... °°° khyad par bshad pa yin <expan>gsung ngo</expan> ||</note></seg></TEI>
